Description.English: Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather is expected to be cool with some light rain patches early today (26th Nov), with minimum temperature around 14 degrees Celsius. The public is advised to pay attention to the weather changes and take appropriate measures. Additionally, due to astronomical tide, seawater inundation is expected within the Inner Harbor area tonight(26th Nov). The public is advised to pay attention. ( Update Time: 2026-11-26 00H10 )
